title: Reuse header/footer layouts across document reports

en.title: Reuse header/footer layouts across document reports
en.summary: With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a header/footer on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output. It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.
